mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a guest bedroom and an independent guest suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard guest bedroom shares the rest of the household's facilities, while an independent living suite contains dedicated amenities that allow long-term privacy and self-sufficiency. A guest room typically uses a shared hallway bathroom and relies on the central home for meals and laundry. An independent living quarters incorporates its own private bathroom, distinct sleeping and sitting areas, and often an efficiency kitchenette or bar area. Independent quarters also frequently incorporate dedicated exterior doors so occupants can enter and exit without disturbing the primary residence.
acceptedAnswer.description: A guest bedroom relies on shared household bathrooms and kitchen spaces, whereas an independent suite includes a dedicated bathroom, living space, and separate food prep areas.
